posts.title: What the Northway Took: the Blue Spruce Motel
posts.description: A closed roadside motel and cottage court in Keeseville, New York, left behind when the Adirondack Northway bypassed the old US 9 corridor.

posts.title: Harrisburg State Hospital and the Question Nobody Answered
posts.description: Harrisburg State Hospital, Pennsylvania's first public asylum, has been mostly torn down for a $450 million state lab complex—and taking a harder question with it.

posts.title: The Long Downturn: How American Blast Furnace Steelmaking Came Apart
posts.description: Weirton's 2024 shutdown was the final blow in a slow 60-year decline: how "mini" mills, legacy costs, and lost marketshare undid American blast furnace steel.
